_what: PRE-REGISTERED class set for criterion C2 of D-119 (the Blendkit one-month trial). Written BEFORE any paid download so the test set is not chosen by the thing under test. Each class names the query strings, the free-tier name-hit census of 2026-08-22 (public API), and two slots that are filled IN ORDER: `free_baseline` (the free tier's first 20 thumbnails through the style panel — docs/blenderkit-month/style-panel-prompt.md — BEFORE any paid fetch in that class) and then `paid_result`. `blenderkit.py status` prints which classes still lack a free baseline.
_why_these: The classes are the ones the critics and the plan already named, not ones picked after seeing the paid shelf: C2 p2r56 #5 (nightstand objects, art, plant, contrast cushion), C3 p2r57 top pick and C2 #5/#6 (hung garments — the P2r-20 class), P4c's 'what must a room of this type contain'. Curtains are NOT a class: the six curtain masses are out of the record camera's frustum. Rug is NOT a class: the D1-A rug is owner-signed and already in the spec. Nightstand and bench are CONTROL classes where the free tier already supplied a panel-passing piece (p2r57) — they are listed so the paid tier can be measured against a class the free tier wins.
_pass_rule: C2 passes when the paid tier supplies at least one piece that (a) passes dim_check in its asset_scale class and (b) the style panel reads inside the Japandi envelope, in >= 3 of the NON-control classes whose free_baseline recorded 0 panel-passing pieces out of 20. A class whose free baseline is not recorded before its first paid fetch does not count toward C2 (it was measured in the wrong order).
census_route: asset_type:model+<words> and +is_free:true, public API, 2026-08-22; `count` saturates at 10,000 (none of these do); an unknown qualifier answers 0, so the is_free split was positive-controlled the same day: scene 1,055+3,420=4,475 and brush 1,256+5,428=6,684 equal the unfiltered counts, hdr 4,952+9,581=14,533 equals the pricing page's own HDRI total.

classes.note: asset_scale has no band for wall art yet — add one WITH A CITED SOURCE before the first fetch (R8: an unknown class must not pass).
branch_dried is the nearest existing band (a cut stem in a vessel, 200-1500 z); a potted plant may need its own band — decide before the fetch, not after.
small objects: the scale band is per object class (books/tray) and must be named at fetch time.
P2r-20 class (R1-stopped as a MECHANISM; acquisition is a different mechanism and enters with its own gate). C3's top pick on p2r57.
